verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an agent-observability platform like Bento, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core product. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: skills and rules stored in your repo as Markdown/YAML, OpenTelemetry export to a Bento endpoint, and running Bento alongside an existing observability stack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
